title: Junior Full Stack Engineer

company.name: FalconPay
company.about: FalconPay builds payment links and invoicing tools for SMEs across the GCC.

description: You'll join a 6-person product squad shipping features on our merchant dashboard and payments API. You'll work across a React/Next.js frontend and a Node.js/PostgreSQL backend, with real ownership from week one.
responsibilities: Build and ship features end to end across frontend and backend
Write and maintain REST APIs used by merchants and internal teams
Write tests and take part in code reviews
Debug production issues with senior engineers
Collaborate with product and design on scoping

must_have.detail: Comfortable building real features, not just tutorials
State management, component design, data fetching
Built at least one REST API with Node.js or similar
Schema design and writing queries, ideally PostgreSQL
Branches, pull requests, reviewing others' code

soft_skills.detail: Takes a task from idea to production

title: Graduate Marketing Executive

company.name: SouqBloom
company.about: SouqBloom is a UAE-based online marketplace for regional fashion and beauty brands.

description: Rotate across performance marketing, social, and influencer partnerships. You'll help plan campaigns aimed at Gen Z shoppers in the UAE and KSA.
responsibilities: Support planning and execution of social and influencer campaigns
Track campaign performance and prepare weekly reports
Coordinate with creators and agencies on deliverables
Contribute content ideas for TikTok and Instagram
Support on-ground activations and university events

must_have.detail: Can read reach, engagement, CTR, conversion
Clear briefs and captions in English

nice_to_have.skill: Experience running a student club or event

soft_skills.detail: Working with creators and external partners

title: Data Analyst Intern

company.name: Dune Mobility
company.about: Dune Mobility runs ride-hailing and last-mile delivery across the UAE.

description: Join the Operations Analytics team to analyse driver supply, delivery times and customer retention, and build dashboards used by city managers.
responsibilities: Write SQL to pull and clean operational data
Build and maintain dashboards in Looker or Power BI
Run ad-hoc analyses and present findings to ops managers
Help design and read A/B tests

must_have.detail: Turns analysis into a clear recommendation

soft_skills.detail: Asks why the numbers look the way they do
